execution_decision.reason: The delta retains actual control interactions, read-only DOM observations, workspace-local evidence writes, headless Firefox at 1280 by 1800, and cleanup. It introduces no subprocess, storage, credential access, sandbox-disable option, or new network destination.
conditions: Before execution, the trusted runner must set sys.argv to [generated_script, --url, selected_allowed_url, --todo, selected_todo] before runpy.run_path. The currently inspected execute_cua.py does not yet forward these arguments and would cause argparse to reject the runner's positional script path.
Keep the approved external Firefox broker, network and tenant sandbox, and exact independent DOM oracle. Synchronize the oracle TODO_VALUE with the CLI --todo argument.
Copy byte-identical code into a new writable final_runs/run_<id> directory for every execution; preserve all preceding logs, screenshots, scripts and review records.

Interpret oracle pass separately from execution exit code. Healthy should satisfy the task oracle; duplicate, no-check and no-theme should fail that oracle in each repeat without being normalized to successful task completion.
Keep all 12 runtime outcomes and any timeouts or unknowns; do not introduce automatic retries or model calls into the model-free experiment.
Re-review any change to the generated script that changes its fixed hash.
